name: racelab-server
description: RaceLab Tier B enrichment API (Vercel functions + Neon Postgres): trial first-seen registry, subscription status, outbox backup push/restore, account deletion. The app works fully with every endpoint down (D4/D18) — this tier only enriches. Zero committed runtime deps: db driver and JWT verification are injected interfaces, wired at deploy time (see src/deploy.ts).
